ja.title: AIが選んだアプタマーは何に結合していたのか
ja.summary: Googleのアプタマー探索報告を読み、結合量・ビーズ背景・標的選択性を区別する。公開集計から閾値別の改善率を再計算し、分母と判定条件の整合性を確認する。

en.title: AI aptamer discovery: what were the molecules binding to?
en.summary: An audit of Google’s aptamer report checks hit-rate denominators, bead correction and unresolved threshold inconsistencies.
en.seo_title: AI aptamer discovery: what were the molecules binding to?
en.seo_description: An audit of Google’s aptamer report checks hit-rate denominators, bead correction and unresolved threshold inconsistencies.

english.title: What were the AI-designed molecules binding to?
english.summary: A Japanese technical essay audits aggregate counts from a Google aptamer discovery report, separating enrichment, bead background and counter-target specificity, while checking thresholds, denominators and limits on causal claims.
